states.entry: Usable interaction has not been checked.
Complete searches found no qualifying order and the review window remains active.
states.exit: Next eligible daily check, explicit force recheck, or window close.

states.entry: No qualifying order by review-window end.
Order-level rep is target_rep or target_rep_web and no blocking value issue exists.
Order-level rep is unassigned_web or another evidence-dependent state.
Deterministic two-way or connected pre-order evidence.
Outbound-only evidence without a customer response.
Same-day evidence cannot be reliably ordered before/after the order.
Another known rep appears on the order.
Material commercial change or placed-value uncertainty.
Qualifying order canceled and replacement window open.
Potential replacement needs non-deterministic continuity review.
Replacement window expired without relevant order.
Missing, invalid, unsupported, or contradictory facts.
Human outcome or terminal no-order/no-replacement result recorded.
states.exit: Minimize active data and begin retention clock.

invariants: One active logical Sales Credit case per synthetic Order Number.
Multiple qualifying interactions attach to the same case without duplicating totals or outcomes.
System classification and human outcome are separate fields.
Ambiguity never becomes an automatic favorable credit decision.
